thread:
anya: quick huddle. exec wants a short plan for the Optimize toolkit pilot (batching + caching + quant) we can commit to in the next planning cycle. two mobile customers, two sprints.
sam: do we agree on non-negotiables? my list: >=20% token cost reduction, p95 latency not worse than baseline+25%, and eval-guard rails for payment flows.
rebecca: customer asks: minimize perceived slowdowns on flaky networks and avoid extra support load. they prefer conservative defaults.
omar: engineering note: safe MVP that hits cost goals = micro-batching (25-60ms windows) + server-side prefix cache + conservative quant (8-bit for <512 tokens). 4-bit only in internal experiments.
lucy: ops history: the last rollout that expanded batching introduced truncated outputs on rare long responses. must include a fast rollback and an eval-trigger that can flip the flag.
sam: rollout idea: feature-flag + staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 24h holds. eval alerts auto-notify and optionally auto-rollback.
rebecca: i'll provide golden prompt sets and baseline labels for the two customers (Voyager, EchoRide). will also coordinate their traffic windows.
omar: acceptance criteria proposal: - token/unit cost reduction >=20% on pilot routes - p50 latency <= baseline+7% and p95 <= baseline+22% - eval-concordance >= 0.97 on golden sets - <=2 SE escalations/week.
lucy: runbook must include: observability queries (per-route concordance, latency histograms), rollback steps, who to call, and a short customer-facing blurb. i'll draft.
sam: eval-alert config draft (lightweight):
```
name: optimize-mobile-pilot
eval_sets: [payments_short, onboarding_short]
metrics:
  concordance: 0.97
  p95_latency_factor: 1.25
actions:
  - notify: #optimize-ops
  - rollback: true
  - create_ticket: ops-triage
```
rebecca: we should also include a small regression prompt set that catches known 4-bit failures; omar, can you add that to the harness?
omar: will add quant-fallback tests and a small curated failure set. also will instrument a "divergence score" (semantic-sim + answer-length delta) for alerts.
anya: scope-shrink option if needed: ship batching + eval-alerts first, move server-side cache to v1.1, quant to opt-in later.
sam: agreed. owner list: sam -> rollout + dashboards; omar -> runtime changes + eval tests; rebecca -> customer golden prompts; lucy -> support/runbook. alert-bot: feature-flag scaffolding merged to staging at 1767010300.
anya: thanks. we'll reconvene Thu to sign-off launch gate. :calendar:
